arm: Full multi-agent loop (Planner, Research, chronology, Skeptic, Writer, Evaluator; two rounds plus one repair draft)
label: v4_2026-10-26_live
selection: the first 10 set-1a questions with a named U.S. product, in file order, fixed before any run

answers.finding: No U.S. label record provided for afatinib; unable to determine if trichomegaly appears in any section.
US label for lenvatinib does not include tumour lysis syndrome warning; FDA AEMS review determined no action necessary based on available information.
US label (Poteligeo v21, effective 2026-03-02) lists 'Immune-mediated colitis' in section 6.2 Postmarketing Experience under Gastrointestinal disorders.
US label (v36, effective 2026-02-09) includes hyperammonemic encephalopathy in Warnings and Precautions (section 5.1 Hepatotoxicity).
Zoloft v7 (2025-07-24) label contains no mention of multiple acyl-coenzyme A dehydrogenase deficiency, MADD, glutaric acidemia type II, or related terms.
US label (Bactrim v18, effective Dec 2024) includes circulatory shock in WARNINGS (Hypersensitivity and Other Serious or Fatal Reactions) and ADVERSE REACTIONS (Cardiovascular System)

Yescarta (axicabtagene ciloleucel) U.S. label v23 (2026-08-06) lists colitis under gastrointestinal disorders in Adverse Reactions but does not name immune-mediated enterocolitis or immune effector cell-associated enteritis.
US label for brodalumab does not mention pyoderma gangrenosum in any section (boxed warning, warnings and precautions, contraindications, adverse reactions, or postmarketing).

Xtandi US label v24 (effective 2026-07-28) includes warning in Warnings and Precautions (section 5.8) and Drug Interactions (section 7.3) about interference with certain digoxin immunoassays resulting in falsely elevated digoxin plasma concentration results.
US label includes hallucinations only as symptom of serotonin syndrome in Section 5.2, not as separate warning unrelated to serotonin syndrome.
